description: Add DashboardScreen with role-based tiles, add AdminPanelScreen as a placeholder (native, not WebView — avoids needing to handle WebView auth session complexity), improve ProfileScreen with navigation cards to Dashboard and Admin Panel, wire all new routes in MainActivity.kt, then build the APK, commit, push, and create a GitHub release. Depends on FEAT-002 for strings.xml additions. Independent of FEAT-001 worker deployments at build time (the app compiles regardless of whether workers are live).
steps: Create android/app/src/main/java/id/go/bgn/radarmbg/ui/screens/DashboardScreen.kt. Composable DashboardScreen(userRole: String, onNavigateToAdminPanel: () -> Unit, onNavigateToLaporan: () -> Unit). Use Scaffold with TopAppBar (title = stringResource(R.string.dashboard_judul), containerColor = BgnPrimary, title color White). Body: LazyColumn with a 2-column grid of ElevatedCard tiles via chunked(2). Tile data is a data class DashboardTile(labelRes: Int, icon: ImageVector, onClick: () -> Unit, isEnabled: Boolean). Build tile list based on userRole: if 'admin' show 5 tiles (KPI Nasional/Assessment icon enabled noop, Manajemen Akun/People icon enabled noop, Status SPPG/CheckCircle enabled noop, Backup Menu/Archive enabled noop, Log Keamanan/Security enabled navigates to AdminPanel); if 'sppg' show 3 tiles (Input Menu/Edit enabled noop, Profil Dapur/Restaurant enabled noop, Laporan Distribusi/BarChart enabled noop); else show 3 tiles (Status Laporan/Assignment enabled navigates to Laporan, Menu Sekolah/MenuBook enabled noop, Kontak Satgas/Phone enabled noop). Disabled tiles show label_fitur_segera subtitle. Enabled tiles have containerColor BgnPrimaryContainer with text color White; disabled tiles use BgnBackground with text BgnOnSurfaceVariant. All icon imports from androidx.compose.material.icons.filled.*. Tile height 120.dp. No hardcoded strings — use stringResource().

Create android/app/src/main/java/id/go/bgn/radarmbg/ui/screens/AdminPanelScreen.kt. Simple native Composable AdminPanelScreen(onBack: () -> Unit). Scaffold with TopAppBar (title = stringResource(R.string.admin_panel_judul), BgnPrimary, navigationIcon = IconButton with Icons.Default.ArrowBack calling onBack()). Body: Column centered, Icon(Icons.Default.AdminPanelSettings, tint BgnPrimary, size 80.dp), Text label_versi_admin (BgnPrimary Bold 18sp), Spacer, Text 'Fitur admin tersedia melalui portal web' (use string resource webview_loading or add a dedicated string 'panel_admin_deskripsi'='Kelola data program MBG melalui portal web resmi Radar MBG.'), Spacer, OutlinedButton 'Buka Portal Admin' onClick opens Intent to https://mbg.jack-ai.my.id/dashboard/admin/ via LocalContext. Add string panel_admin_deskripsi and btn_buka_portal to strings.xml inside this step.

Edit android/app/src/main/java/id/go/bgn/radarmbg/ui/screens/ProfileScreen.kt. Add parameter onNavigateToDashboard: () -> Unit and onNavigateToAdminPanel: () -> Unit to the composable signature. In the body Column (after the sppg_name Text and before the Spacer(40.dp)), add a section header Text(stringResource(R.string.dashboard_judul), fontWeight=SemiBold, fontSize=14sp, color=BgnOnSurfaceVariant) and three ElevatedCard nav items using a helper NavCard composable: (1) card_buka_dashboard (Icons.Default.Dashboard) always shown, onClick = onNavigateToDashboard; (2) card_panel_admin (Icons.Default.AdminPanelSettings) shown only if user?.role == 'admin', onClick = onNavigateToAdminPanel; (3) card_laporan_aduan (Icons.Default.Report) always shown, onClick = {} (noop for now, laporan screen exists via bottom nav). Each NavCard: ElevatedCard fillMaxWidth, padding 12.dp, Row with Icon (24.dp BgnPrimary) + Column (title Text 14sp BgnOnSurface + subtitle Text 12sp BgnOnSurfaceVariant) + Spacer(weight 1f) + Icon ChevronRight (BgnOnSurfaceVariant). Add strings panel_admin_deskripsi, btn_buka_portal to strings.xml here if not done in step 2.

Edit android/app/src/main/java/id/go/bgn/radarmbg/MainActivity.kt. Add imports for DashboardScreen and AdminPanelScreen. In the outer NavHost (not MainScaffold inner NavHost), add two new composable routes: composable('dashboard') { val role = (authViewModel.uiState.value as? AuthUiState.Success)?.user?.role ?: ''; DashboardScreen(userRole = role, onNavigateToAdminPanel = { navController.navigate('admin_panel') }, onNavigateToLaporan = { navController.navigate('main') }) }; composable('admin_panel') { AdminPanelScreen(onBack = { navController.popBackStack() }) }. Edit the composable('profile') block to pass the new lambdas to ProfileScreen: onNavigateToDashboard = { navController.navigate('dashboard') }, onNavigateToAdminPanel = { navController.navigate('admin_panel') }.
Build the APK: run `cd c:\laragon\www\MBG-MONITORING\android; .\gradlew.bat assembleDebug` from PowerShell. Confirm BUILD SUCCESSFUL. APK is at android\app\build\outputs\apk\debug\Radar-MBG-V2.apk.

Commit all changed files: git add workers/wrangler-data.toml workers/wrangler-menu.toml android/app/src/main/java/id/go/bgn/radarmbg/data/api/DataApiService.kt android/app/src/main/java/id/go/bgn/radarmbg/data/api/MenuApiService.kt android/app/src/main/java/id/go/bgn/radarmbg/data/api/ApiClient.kt android/app/src/main/java/id/go/bgn/radarmbg/data/repository/DataRepository.kt android/app/src/main/java/id/go/bgn/radarmbg/ui/screens/ProfileScreen.kt android/app/src/main/java/id/go/bgn/radarmbg/ui/screens/DashboardScreen.kt android/app/src/main/java/id/go/bgn/radarmbg/ui/screens/AdminPanelScreen.kt android/app/src/main/java/id/go/bgn/radarmbg/MainActivity.kt android/app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml. Then: git commit -m 'feat: data workers + DashboardScreen + ProfileScreen nav cards + fix HTTP 500'
Push to remote: git push origin main

Create a GitHub release with the APK. Get current tag: git describe --tags --abbrev=0 (if no tag, use v2.1.0). Create tag: git tag v2.1.0 (increment if tag already exists). Push tag: git push origin v2.1.0. Create release: gh release create v2.1.0 android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/Radar-MBG-V2.apk --title 'Radar MBG v2.1.0 — Data Workers Fix + Dashboard' --notes 'Fix HTTP 500 pada Beranda dan Menu Hari Ini dengan deploy standalone Cloudflare Workers. Tambah DashboardScreen berbasis peran dan navigasi profil.'
acceptance_criteria: DashboardScreen.kt exists with role-based tile logic for admin/sppg/user roles
AdminPanelScreen.kt exists with back navigation and portal link button
ProfileScreen.kt shows nav cards (Dashboard, Admin Panel for admin only, Laporan & Aduan) and accepts onNavigateToDashboard and onNavigateToAdminPanel lambdas
MainActivity.kt has 'dashboard' and 'admin_panel' routes in the outer NavHost, profile route passes the new lambdas
No hardcoded Indonesian strings in any new or modified Compose file
git log --oneline shows the new commit
GitHub release created with APK attached
verification: cd c:\laragon\www\MBG-MONITORING\android; .\gradlew.bat assembleDebug — confirm BUILD SUCCESSFUL
gh release view v2.1.0 — confirm release exists with APK asset
findings: GitHub release v2.1.0 created at https://github.com/fxcomunity/mbg-monitoring/releases/tag/v2.1.0 with APK Radar-MBG-V2.apk (29.29 MiB) attached. BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 36s. Commit 8147a15.
